architecture.note: Controllers are kept thin and pass validated data to service classes.
Business rules are placed in app/Services, especially AccountFees, Transactions, Reports, Notifications, and Support.
Blade views display prepared data only and do not perform fee or report calculations.
Logging is handled through reusable services such as BankingLogger.
Admin routes are protected by AdminMiddleware and session user_role checks.

accountFees.rule: First withdrawal each month is free; every extra monthly withdrawal costs 5.00.
Monthly maintenance fee is 20.00 when monthly input is less than 2000.00.

withdrawals.note: Withdrawal transactions are persisted in Strapi with transactionType Withdrawal and transferType Withdrawal.
The transaction relation uses the numeric Strapi account id.
The account balance update uses the Strapi documentId endpoint when available.
Session data is refreshed from Strapi after transaction and balance update success.

netIncomeReport.note: The report calculates fees collected, estimated interest paid, and net income.
Fee categories are Monthly Account Fees, Savings Withdrawal Fees, and Other Fees.

notifications.note: Admin notification settings are stored in Strapi and checked before customer toast messages are displayed.
Disabled events suppress notification toasts; enabled events allow the success confirmation message.

supportChat.note: Customers can create support issues, mark bot replies resolved, request a consultant, and rate resolved tickets.
Support chat data is stored in the Strapi support-ticket collection.
